name: Westerkappeln (Germany)
description: Square red flag charged with the shieldless municipal arms of Westerkappeln, a white saint holding a yellow palm frond and an anchor.
history: Municipal flag of Westerkappeln; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: saint with palm frond and anchor from the municipal arms
